extra.message: The registration handler passes request.form["password"] directly to the User model and commits it without hashing. A database compromise would expose every user's plaintext password.

cwe: CWE-256: Plaintext Storage of a Password

extra.message: The GET /logout endpoint changes session state without CSRF protection. An attacker can embed a cross-origin request that forcibly logs a victim out.
The /evaluate route has no authentication check despite the application's session-based login flow. Anonymous attackers can directly access its expression-evaluation functionality.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: User-controlled request.form["expression"] is passed directly to eval(). An attacker can execute arbitrary Python code with the application's privileges.

cwe: CWE-95: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection')

extra.message: The attacker-controlled result of eval(expression) is concatenated directly into an HTML response without escaping. An expression returning HTML or JavaScript executes in the requesting browser.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: The /lookup route performs operating-system commands without checking session authentication. Anonymous attackers can invoke this critical functionality directly.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: User-controlled request.form["address"] is concatenated into a shell command passed through rp() to os.popen(). Shell metacharacters allow arbitrary operating-system command execution.

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

extra.message: The output of a user-controlled shell command is concatenated directly into an HTML response without escaping. Injected command output containing HTML or JavaScript executes in the browser.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: The /xml route parses attacker-supplied XML without checking session authentication. Anonymous attackers can directly invoke the unsafe parser.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: Attacker-supplied XML is parsed with DTD validation and network access enabled, without disabling entity resolution. External entities can read local resources or initiate server-side requests.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: The /sayhi route renders a dynamically constructed template without checking session authentication. Anonymous attackers can directly invoke the critical template-rendering functionality.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: The name form parameter is embedded directly into template source before rendering. HTML or JavaScript supplied as the name is emitted without contextual escaping and executes in the browser.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: User-controlled request.form["name"] is inserted into Jinja template source using Python string formatting and then passed to render_template_string(). Jinja expressions supplied by an attacker are evaluated and can lead to arbitrary code execution.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine
